# citoMove

The goal of citoMove is to provide an user-friendly R package for analyzing movement data with DNNs.

## Installation

This version of citoMove depends on the **development** version of cito, which can be installed via:


```{r, eval = F}
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github('citoverse/cito')
```

Then, install the provided R package file via 

```{r, eval = F}
install.packages("../citoMove_0.1.0.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type="source")
```

of course changing the .. to the path on your computer.

For a simple example of how to use the package, see

```{r}
vignette("Introduction", package = "citoMove")
```
